source.grid: 128x128 half-open periodic [-pi, pi)^2, zero initial velocities

selection_contract: Four Experiment-020 early-flip controls cover both arms, both signs, and reflection symmetry.
Grid cells nearest selected native first-flip times probe both sides of decade boundaries and the interiors of the 10-100 and 100-1000 decades.
Four energy-accessible cells censored through H=1000 represent one long-lived region in each open angle quadrant.
Four cells straddle the strict E=-g energy-accessibility boundary without treating equality as inaccessible.
The known H=1000 native/reference disagreement and its exact grid reflection are retained explicitly.
Two energy-inaccessible controls include the stable equilibrium and a non-equilibrium oscillatory state.
